name: zebrafish (Danio rerio), adult
reproduces: NOT the 189-piece anatomy-model/zebrafish/build_adult.py; this is the same generic-teleost parametric body plan driven by zebrafish measurements, at lower detail. The detailed zebrafish-adult.glb remains the anatomical reference.

standard_length_m.source: development/zebrafish/trajectory.mjs at(180 d); von Bertalanffy fit, Parichy 2009 + FishBase

body_mass_kg.source: Beaudouin 2015 ln W(mg) = -5.24 + 3.22 ln SL(mm), extrapolated above 15 mm

body_depth_over_SL.source: Parichy DM et al. 2009 Dev Dyn Table 3 regressions / FishBase morphometrics, via development/zebrafish/trajectory.mjs proportions()

body_width_over_SL.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement; no zebrafish width/SL fetched

body_section_exponent.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement

head_fraction_SL.source: Parichy DM et al. 2009 Dev Dyn Table 3 regressions / FishBase morphometrics, via development/zebrafish/trajectory.mjs proportions()

peduncle_depth_frac.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement

peduncle_width_frac.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement

pectoral_len_over_SL.source: NO fetched source measures pectoral length / SL in a wild-type zebrafish (genotype/compare-2x2.json panel A: 'NOT MEASURED IN ANY FETCHED SOURCE'). 0.155 is an assumed placeholder read off the needlefish-halfbeak end of the Daane series; it is NOT a zebrafish datum.

pectoral_span_over_SL.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement; follows the assumed fin length

pectoral_area_over_SL2.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement; follows the assumed fin length

pectoral_ray_count.source: zebrafish pectoral lepidotrichia ~11-13 (anatomy literature via anatomy-model/zebrafish/sources.json)

pelvic_len_over_SL.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement

dorsal_height_over_SL.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement

anal_height_over_SL.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement

caudal_upper_lobe_over_SL.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement; zebrafish caudal is homocercal and forked

caudal_lower_lobe_over_SL.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement; equal lobes = homocercal

myomere_count.source: set equal to the vertebra count (schematic link, as in anatomy-model/zebrafish/build_adult.py)

flight_muscle_fraction.source: no zebrafish pectoral-muscle mass fraction fetched; a small placeholder for an ordinary-finned teleost
